title: Roasted Tofu in a Canadian Indian-Style Custard
description: A unique and flavorful dish that combines the richness of custard with the savory taste of roasted tofu, inspired by the spices and techniques of Canadian-Indian cuisine.
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet.
Roast the tofu in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a blender or food processor, combine the custard powder, coconut milk, garam masala, cumin powder, cayenne pepper, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Pour the custard mixture into a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Add the roasted tofu to the saucepan and stir to coat with the custard mixture.
Serve the tofu in the custard sauce hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
